title: Little Nachman, Part 24
body:
with translation by Rabbi Lazer Brody
and illustrations by Rebecca Shapiro
 

Little Nachman – Part 24

A few days later, Nachman saw Aaron in the park. This time, Aaron seemed genuinely happy.

"Nachman, my wonderful friend," said Aaron with a big smile on his face, "Thank you for teaching me to pray and to thank Hashem. Hashem heard all my prayers and my requests. I never imagined that He’d answer me so fast and grant my wishes. I’ve learned to ask Hashem for everything and to pray to Him all the time. Now, I’ll start asking Him for all my needs – He really listens to me!"

Aaron prayed for good grades in school, that his parents should have good health and livelihood, and that his brothers and sisters should have success as well. He also prayed that all the people of Israel should be tzaddikim.

"Nachman, my wonderful friend," said Aaron with a big smile on his face…

To be continued, G-d willing.
